text:
Tomorrow is it! TechCrunch Founder Summit, presented by Fidelity Private Shares, brings founders and investors together at Boston’s SoWa Power Station for a full day focused on building what comes next.
Secure your ticket savings before prices increase when doors open at 9 a.m. ET. Whether you’re attending solo, bringing a co-founder, or rallying your team, there’s a deal for everyone:
- Just for you: Save up to $100 on your ticket.
- Bringing a partner or co-founder? Buy one ticket and get a second pass free
- Registering a group of 4–12? Save 15%
- Bringing a group of 13 or more? Get 30% off
Don’t wait until doors open. Lock in your savings now.
Practical takeaways to scale your startup
One day to tackle the questions founders carry all year:
- How do you know you have a real product-market fit?
- When is it actually time to scale?
- What does an investor need to hear before agreeing to another meeting?
- How do you build a team that can keep up?
- How do you win enterprise customers when you’re still early?
- Can you build a category-defining company outside Silicon Valley?
Founder Summit puts those questions at the center of the day. Explore the full agenda to get to know the scaling experts leading the sessions.
Choose how you want to learn
Head to the Build Stage for tactical lessons around fundraising, distribution, teams, and pitching.
Use the Impact Stage to think about product-market fit, scale, enterprise relationships, and long-term growth.
Go deeper in smaller roundtable conversations.
Watch founders put their stories to the test during the live pitch competition.
Use the Braindate networking app to connect one-on-one or in small groups with people who want to talk about the same problems you do.
Then keep the conversation going at the closing reception.
Save on your pass before doors open tomorrow
You can read founder advice online all year. Tomorrow is about asking the question yourself. Meeting the person. Hearing the answer firsthand. Finding the idea you can take back to your team the next morning. If Founder Summit has been sitting on your calendar as a maybe, this is your final call.
TechCrunch Founder Summit, presented by Fidelity Private Shares, takes place tomorrow, November 4, at SoWa Power Station in Boston. Register now and save on your pass before doors open tomorrow at 9 a.m. ET.
digest_he:
פסגת היזמים של TechCrunch מתקיימת מחר בתחנת הכוח סווה שבוסטון, ומפגישה יזמים ומשקיעים ליום שלם המוקדש לצמיחה עסקית ובניית השלב הבא במיזמים. האירוע מציע ליווי מעשי לשאלות מרכזיות המעסיקות יזמים, כגון התאמת מוצר לשוק, גיוס הון, הרחבת פעילות ובניית צוותים.

המשתתפים יוכלו לבחור בין במות שונות המציעות שיעורים טקטיים בנושאי גיוס כספים, הפצה ופיתוח ארוך טווח, לצד סבבי שולחנות עגולים, תחרות פיץ' חיה ואפשרויות נטוורקינג. מחירי הכרטיסים המוזלים וההנחות לקבוצות תקפים עד לפתיחת הדלתות מחר בבוקר.
